title: The Jews Flee to Egypt
description: After the prophet Jeremiah has warned against fleeing to Egypt, Azariah, Johanan and the proud men accuse him of speaking lies and charge Baruch with inciting them against them. They do not obey the Lord's voice, but take with them the whole remnant of Judah – including Jeremiah and Baruch – and go to Tahpanhes in Egypt. There the Lord gives Jeremiah a sign: he is to bury large stones at the entrance to Pharaoh's house, for Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, will come and set his throne over them, strike Egypt, burn the temples of the gods and break the pillars in Heliopolis [ref:Jer 43:1-13|Jeremiah 43:1-13].
